model.name: GUARD#6 partial-write false-positive bricks CREATE_ROOM for a distinct-primary-no-redirect creator (an ABSENT members field is read as an explicit drop-all)
model.description: ARCHITECT-DIAGNOSED, code-grounded (robbin-architect, PO-approved routing, 2026-09-12; robbin-req verified the cited sites). CREATE_ROOM THROWS when the creator's member is a DISTINCT PRIMARY with NO redirect. ROOT: Room.persist() (Room.ts:394-403, impl Room.persistMembers R19.35 d5f0c2b4) writes room.json WITH members (creator=owner). Immediately after, server.ts:4805 calls writeRoomJson AGAIN with a PARTIAL object (updates id/name/ssh/state/chatHistory; OMITS members — and also files/visibility/mode). GUARD#6 (RoomKeys.ts:192-206, shipped for R40.107 / 58175f768) reads `data.members || [] = []` -> treats the ABSENT field as dropping ALL stored members -> for a stored member that is a distinct primary with no redirect it is `!benign` -> throws @4805 BEFORE ROOM_JOINED. The guard is preventing a real data-loss (the partial overwrite would drop members/files) but does so by BRICKING instead of PRESERVING. ★ SEVERITY WIDENED (architect re-open 2026-09-12, node-read past a grep-silent-fail; robbin-req CODE-CONFIRMED the benign-logic): GUARD#6's benign-check is ALWAYS-FALSE for the @4805 EMPTY-members write — writtenTokens & writtenPrimaries are both empty, so benign = (prim!==st) && (false||false) = false for ANY stored member (redirect or not; only the `why` string differs, both throw). So it likely bricks ALL room creation since the guard went live at v0.8.212 (2026-09-12), NOT just onboarding. The '1 room post-guard' (SystemTester) was created 09-09 = PREDATES the live guard = NOT a counterexample (my earlier benign-resolved note was WRONG). ★ GATE CASE = ONBOARDING (PO): a brand-new SINGLE-PROFILE user's FIRST room via the REAL CREATE_ROOM onboarding path — every new person Tron invites hits a hard failure on their first action while existing users are fine and prod looks healthy (worst shape: invisible to those who work, fatal to those arriving). SEVERITY LABEL is PENDING tester's explicit ONBOARDING-repro confirmation: reproduces via onboarding -> 'new-user onboarding broken'; only in the seeded rig -> 'fresh-rig edge case'.
model.fix: BY-CONSTRUCTION (architect): writeRoomJson PARTIAL-MERGE — an ABSENT members field = PRESERVE stored (no-change); GUARD#6 scrutinizes a drop ONLY when members is EXPLICITLY provided (`members in data`, NOT `data.members || []`). Protects every partial caller regardless of resolver state. This EMBODIES R40.107's own principle: a write must not mutate fields it was not asked to change — an absent field was not asked to change. Alt-local (rejected as lossy): @4805 carry members, or remove @4805 (redundant since persist() wrote authoritative room.json, but @4805 also omits files/visibility/mode). Expert owns the fix; chain against the built fix.
model.severity: HIGH/onboarding CONFIRMED (tester 2026-09-12, real onboarding path) — MAY ESCALATE to CRITICAL/universal. Case (a) new-user first-room CREATE_ROOM THROWS at GUARD#6: PROVEN on the isolated ship-bytes rig (blob 275580532, guard live) — brand-new single-profile user (token 2e97607b) -> 'GUARD#6 REFUSED room 30946ee2: member 2e97607b would be silently dropped — no redirect'. Mechanism is data-independent (empty-members @4805 write; benign always-false). Case (b) existing-redirect createRoom running now: if it ALSO refuses -> CRITICAL/universal (all room creation broken since v0.8.212 2026-09-12). PROD: repro FORBIDDEN (hard rule: no fresh test users on prod) -> prod evidence is OBSERVATIONAL only (PO checks any room createdAt > 2026-09-12T14:19).

model.crossRefNote: The defect is in GUARD#6, shipped for R40.107 (fe7788d7 'a WRITE must not mutate fields it was not asked to change') and gated by 80ca8e83 AC-2 (room-persist-invariant / check:room-persist-invariant). The fix RESTORES R40.107's own principle (absent field = not-asked-to-change = preserve), so the guard stops firing on partial writes while keeping its teeth on explicit drops. Related to the identity-coupled-to-profile hazard family.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A PARTIAL write with NO members field PRESERVES the stored members (no-change) — writeRoomJson merges, it does not treat absent-members as drop-all. BITE: a @4805-shaped partial write (no members field) leaves the stored member(s) intact in room.json.

gateRef.assertion: after a partial writeRoomJson without a members field, room.json still contains the previously-stored members byte-for-byte; a partial write that drops/omits stored members => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a partial write (no members field) that results in stored members being dropped -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: GUARD#6 KEEPS ITS TEETH: an EXPLICIT members-array that drops a distinct-primary-no-redirect member STILL refuses (throws). The fix narrows the guard to `members in data`, it does NOT disable it.

gateRef.assertion: an explicit members array omitting a stored distinct-primary-no-redirect member => GUARD#6 throws (refuses); if it passes => RED
